rows.description: I keep asking a friend what she is hiding. Curiosity is human, but pressing invades her space. Wise: say I am here if you want to talk and then let it go. Trust means giving her the choice.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: betrayal, coercion, gratitude, guilt, temptation, trust

rows.description: Everyone whispers about a girl's family trouble and I want to know too. Gossip feels like belonging, but it is built on someone else's pain. I can listen less, change the topic and not pass it on.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear, guilt, honesty, humiliation, loyalty
related mind states: curiosity, nostalgia, hurt

rows.description: I spread a rumour because she was mean to me. It gives quick satisfaction but grows out of control. Wise: tell her directly or ask a teacher. Rumours cannot be recalled once released.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, curiosity, fear, guilt, honesty, humiliation

rows.description: I discover a rumour about me is everywhere, and I feel exposed and want to disappear. It is not my fault. I tell a trusted adult, ask the source to stop, and hold onto friends who know me.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, curiosity, fear, guilt, honesty, loyalty

rows.description: My friends are gossiping about someone I like. I do not join and say that is not nice. Wise loyalty includes not being cruel to absent people. If I am uneasy, I can leave.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, curiosity, fear, guilt, honesty, humiliation

rows.description: I fear that if I do not gossip, they will gossip about me. Fear of exclusion drives many kids. A friend who requires cruelty is not safe. Wise: stay polite, stay out, find kinder friends.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, curiosity, guilt, honesty, humiliation, loyalty

rows.description: I repeated something that turned out to be false and the girl cried. I feel awful. I go to her, say sorry, and correct the rumour. Guilt is a chance to become kinder.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, curiosity, fear, honesty, humiliation, loyalty

rows.description: I imagine how it feels to be the talked-about one. Empathy stops me repeating hurtful stories. I can say what if it were about you, and kindly change the subject.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, fear, guilt, honesty, humiliation, loyalty

rows.description: A friend passes me stories about others, then asks for secrets in return. I notice she uses information to feel powerful. I share less with her and stay careful. Friendship should not feel like trading.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, curiosity, fear, guilt, honesty, humiliation

rows.description: The teacher hears about the rumour and calls me. I feel scared. Honest answer: I say what I did and apologise. Consequences hurt, but lying will hurt more.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, curiosity, fear, guilt, honesty, humiliation
